login.title: Sign in
login.login_label: Mobile no., user name or email
login.lineman_hint: Linemen sign in on the phone app.

error.title: Could not sign in
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
error.role_not_allowed: This login is for the phone app. Linemen sign in on the phone, not here.
error.account_disabled: Your account is switched off. Call your owner or office.
error.invalid_code: Wrong code. Look at the app and type the new code.
error.two_factor_expired: This took too long. Sign in again.
error.sign_in_again: 2-step sign-in did not turn on. Sign in again and try once more.
error.invalid_token: This link does not work any more. Ask for a new link.
error.invalid_password: Use 8 to 128 letters, numbers or signs.
error.passwords_differ: The two passwords are not the same.
error.setup_link_required: 2-step sign-in is not set up for this admin account. Ask for a new setup link.

notice.password_changed: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
notice.admin_setup_done: Your admin account is ready. Sign in with your password and the code.

two_factor.title: Enter code
two_factor.description: Open your authenticator app. Type the 6-digit code for Cable Billing.

two_factor_setup.title: Turn on 2-step sign-in
two_factor_setup.description: Admins need a code from an authenticator app every time they sign in.
two_factor_setup.add_key: Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, …):
two_factor_setup.backup_description: If you lose your phone, each code works once. Save them somewhere safe now. They are shown only once.

reset.title: Forgot password
reset.description: Type your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.
reset.sent: If this email has an account, we sent a link to it. The link works once, for 1 hour.
reset.lineman_hint: Linemen: ask your owner to change your password.

reset_new.title: New password
reset_new.description: Type your new password two times.

email.reset_subject: Set a new password for Cable Billing
email.reset_intro: Someone asked to set a new password for your Cable Billing account.
email.reset_action: Open this link to set it. It works once, for {minutes} minutes:
email.reset_ignore: If it was not you, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

admin_setup.title: Set up your admin account
admin_setup.description: Set your password and turn on 2-step sign-in. This link works once.
admin_setup.invalid: This setup link does not work any more. Ask for a new setup link.
admin_setup.start_intro: You need an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Authy, …).
